coach_labels: Your back foot isn't lifting properly, your hips aren't rotating, and your arms are too tense. This tension in your body is preventing normal shoulder rotation. Also, your stance has too much weight on your toes, which is causing your center of gravity to be too high.
Don't telegraph your rear hand punch.
The punches aren't solid, and your right hand isn't in the guard position. Also, you're not rotating your hips.
